notes.title: Update 2022.10.02
notes.content:
NEW: Input icons for dialogs and UI
 FIX: set angle back to same as previously on reset

notes.title: Update 2022.10.01
notes.content:
An update with couple of fixes, namely:


 FIX: Fixed stored angles for respective launchers
 FIX: Gamepad Virtual cursor
 FIX: level finished dialog second time open
 FIX: exit dialog too small
 FIX: pause twice from main menu
 FIX: cursor disappears in model dialogs

notes.title: Update 2022.09.27
notes.content: Fixed stored angles for respective launchers

notes.title: Version 2022.09.16
notes.content:
Whoa! What a week! Neutrino was played in a live stream, and couple of small fixes and improvements have been done. here are they:


 FIX: Fixed stars in campaign
 FIX: Visual improvement: Boss Weak nodes
 FIX: Visual improvement: Bomb
 FIX: Visual improvement: Angle Changers
 NEW: Better feedback when decreased hearts
 NEW: Controls rotation animation
 FIX: Removed useless white boxes from Highscores
 FIX: Fixed reaching level 13

notes.title: Version 2022.09.09
notes.content:
New patch with a bunch of fixes and improvements! We are now approaching the release date, and the main focus has been on fixing and polishing the existing functions.


 FIX: Sound and visual effects on final boss
 FIX: Disabled stats UI toggle for simplification
 FIX: Tutorial completely changed so that it's integrated in level 01
 NEW: Level 13 with final boss and credits finished
 NEW: Supernova ability
 FIX: Replaced O key by ENTER
 FIX: Smaller fixes on Portuguese translation

notes.title: Version 2022.09.04
notes.content:
Now user can chose a language even if it's not available in Steam preferences, and language selected in settings is priority, unless it's chosen "Platform Choice", which takes it from Steam.


 NEW: Language Selector in Settings page

notes.title: Version 2022.09.03
notes.content:
In this update, we bring a couple of fixes and improvements related to balancing and localization.


 FIX: Dialog for the last level
 FIX: Balanced levels 11 and 12
 NEW: Albanian translation (thanks Marvin Hoxha)
 FIX: Corrections on Italian translation (thanks Nicola Zanon)
 FIX: New UI font supporting extended latin characters

notes.title: Version 2022.09.02
notes.content:
This version is mostly about balancing rooms in terms of difficulty level and fine-repositioning items, so that there's a more smooth flow along the game. That's not finished though, in special for the last 3 levels, that are still to be balanced properly


 NEW: Shows game version on top bar in main menu
 FIX: Removed XXX from URL label
 FIX: Balanced levels from 5 to 10
 FIX: Spread stars in similar counts in levels

notes.title: Version 2022.09.01
notes.content:
With this version, you can see in the campaign page in which star level you managed to accomplish for each of the levels. If you collected more than 90% of stars along that level, you get 3 stars for it! 50% of stars collected and you have 2 stars on the button!

Also improved sound effects and added some that were missing, and finally added translation corrections for Spanish, French and Italian.


 NEW: Show stars per level on campaign page
 FIX: Corrections on Spanish translation
 FIX: New sound effects for bomb, room victory and level up
 FIX: Sounds when lost a heart
 FIX: Game Music to not play  while in main menu
 FIX: Fixed labels for mouse control

notes.title: Version 2022.08.30
notes.content:
Wow, a couple of new stuff at once!


 NEW: All coins replaced by stars or helpers
 NEW: Fixed tutorial on start
 NEW: Introduced helper line after 30 seconds
 NEW: Introduced ripple effect after 30 seconds
 NEW: Replaced coins by stars
 NEW: Changed fixed UI, with panes
 FIX: Balancing levels 3 and 4
 NEW: Translation to Spanish
 NEW: Translation to Italian
 NEW: Translation to French

notes.title: Version 2022.08.27
notes.content:
NEW: Button to clear prefs now shows a confirmation dialog
 FIX: Setting to save screenshots is now disabled by default
 FIX: Balancing levels 1 and 2

notes.title: Version 2022.08.26.B
notes.content:
Another update, focused on improvements on UI.


 NEW: Modal Window for level completed
 NEW: Modal Window for game over
 NEW: Enabled mouse cursor back
 FIX: Wrong bright wall on room 1 of level 9

notes.title: Version 2022.08.26
notes.content:
New version introducing a general improvement on the in-game visual, and simplifying how "New Game" button works.


 NEW: Improved in-game visual
 FIX: Removed button "Restart Level"
 FIX: Button "New Game" now starts from latest played level

notes.title: Version 2022.08.24
notes.content:
This version introduces language support.

Languages supported:


 English
 German
 Brazilian Portuguese
 European Portuguese


Languages to introduce soon:


 Spanish
 French

notes.title: Version 2022.08.15
notes.content:
Now we have hearts, so that some of the hard rooms are easier out a bit. You can earn up to 3 hearts and when hit a red bomb, you would lose a heart instead of having a game over - provided that you have at least 1 heart available 😄


 FIX: Launch button with Gamepad
 NEW: Health bar and up to 3 hearts

notes.title: Version 2022.08.14
notes.content:
This version from August 14th, 2022 has a couple of bug fixes, in special about 


 FIX: Rotation was not up to date when a room started
 FIX: Colliders with non-noticiable narrow spacing or little tips that caused bad physics
 FIX: reset input
 FIX: rotation bigger than 360° must be simplified
 FIX: bug on main menu top bar with multiple pages were active
 NEW:: introduced partial support for Gamepad joysticks

notes.title: Update Notes August 9th 2022
notes.content:
Hey there!

Here we go with the changes in this version from August 9th


 CHANGED: "Mouse Sensitivity" to "Aim Sensitivity" so that keys are also affected equally
 CHANGED: the input system has entirely changed internally, so that it supports keyboard better and joystick controllers in the future as well
 NEW: space bar to both launch or reset the photon bullet
 NEW: keys WASD and arrows to rotate the aim and change sensitivity
 FIX: (an attempt on fixing) how increment of rotation degrees and sensitivity
